title: Deterministic GUID and Service Registry Schema
description: Schema for Windows Installer (MSI) component identity, deterministic UpgradeCodes, ComponentId GUIDs, and shared service metadata.

components.description: Dictionary of standalone component specifications indexed by component name

upgrade_code.description: Permanent Windows Installer UpgradeCode GUID for this component lineage

component_guid.description: Primary shared ComponentId GUID for binary/service reference counting

service_name.description: Windows Service name registered in SCM (null if runtime/non-daemon)

default_port.description: Default TCP port component listens on (null if non-networked)

install_dir.description: Standard target directory for component installation

shared_dll_ref_count.description: Whether component participates in Windows Installer shared reference counting
